findings.headline: Award pedigree is a quality multiplier, not a standalone signal — it only pays off on already-good players.
findings.effect: Award breadth is inert on low-quality acquisitions and strongly positive on high-quality ones.
findings.stat_summary: Within-quality terciles, award-breadth slope on WAR: low-Q=-0.43, mid=+0.29, hi-Q=+1.75. 2x2 means: low-quality award breadth inert (0.58 vs 0.56 WAR); high-quality adds +0.60 WAR (0.91->1.51). Interaction p=7.7e-8, n=2187. Replicates on dollar_surplus (p=2.8e-6) and surplus_wins (p=3e-4).
findings.gm_action: Never pay an award-name premium on a reclamation project; award pedigree only converts to value on already-quality targets. The market prices the name up everywhere.
findings.novelty: The published award-breadth article found a main effect; this shows the effect is conditional on quality — a multiplier structure the market ignores.

findings.headline: A hot current-season WAR carries forward for rebuilders but decays for contenders — the deadline market assumes the opposite.
findings.effect: Hot-player WAR predicts post-trade WAR strongly for rebuilding acquirers, weakly for contending acquirers.
findings.stat_summary: Hot-YTD-WAR slope on war_delta: rebuilders 0.91, contenders 0.42. Interaction p=2.2e-4, n=3846.
findings.gm_action: Contenders should discount mid-season WAR spikes on rentals; rebuilders' buy-low-on-a-hot-player lane is real and underused.
findings.novelty: Inverts deadline folklore — the team most likely to overpay for a hot rental (the contender) is the team that captures the least of that hot streak.

findings.headline: The international-pipeline edge is age-gated — it only helps young acquired players.
findings.effect: International roster share predicts acquired-player WAR gains for young players, near-zero for old.
findings.stat_summary: Intl-born% slope on war_delta: young 0.86, old 0.08. Interaction p=1.9e-5, n=3825.
findings.gm_action: Apply the international-pipeline premium only to younger acquisitions; it does not transfer to veteran pickups.
findings.novelty: Extends the published international-pipeline finding into conditional form.
